title: Pacman

grid.note: 19 columns x 21 rows. Build the maze with kit.makeTilemap.

maze.legend: # = wall (solid), . = pellet, space = empty corridor, P = player start, G = ghost start

entities.desc: Pacman. Sits on the grid, size ~ one tile. Faces a direction; the player queues a direction with arrow keys and Pacman turns onto it at the next aligned corridor. Moves at a steady speed, blocked by # walls.

3-4 ghosts starting at the G cells. Each moves along corridors at a steady speed, choosing a new direction at intersections (a simple wander: don't reverse unless dead-ended is fine — real chase AI NOT required). Blocked by walls.
One pellet on every '.' cell. Pacman eating a cell's pellet removes it and scores 1.

mechanics: movement is grid-aligned: entities travel cell-to-cell along open corridors; a wall tile (#) blocks entry
Pacman eats the pellet on any cell he enters; track pellets remaining
if a ghost occupies the same cell as Pacman, the player loses
when every pellet is eaten, the player wins
render: draw walls as blue rects, pellets as small light dots, Pacman as a yellow circle, ghosts as colored circles/rects, and the score as text
